description: This file defines a custom exception class 'BadRequestException' in the OrangeHRM project, which extends the base PHP Exception class. It is part of the API V2 Exception namespace and provides a specific error type for HTTP 400 Bad Request errors.

classes.name: BadRequestException
classes.description: A custom exception class representing a 'Bad Request' error in the API, extending PHP's base Exception class.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of BadRequestException with an optional custom message, code, and previous exception.
